US Envoy Downplays Command Rename, Highlights Strong India-US Ties and Trade Deal

US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor addressed the U.S.-India Strategic Partnership Forum, downplaying concerns over the renaming of the Indo-Pacific Command by stating that the "name on the letterhead" is less important than actual actions. He emphasized the strong defense relationship, noting India conducts more military exercises with the US than any other country. Gor also indicated that a trade deal between the US and India is in its final stages, nearing completion.
